final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT p.bats, COUNT(*) as count FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.bats != '' GROUP BY p.bats), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.bats, s1.count, CAST(s1.count AS REAL) / s2.total as proportion FROM step1 s1, step2 s2), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(count AS REAL)) as avg_count FROM step3) SELECT s3.bats, s3.count, s3.proportion, CAST(s3.count AS REAL) / s4.avg_count as normalized FROM step3 s3, step4 s4
